title: Inverse Scaling: When Bigger Isn’t Better
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and benchmarking 'inverse scaling' trends in Large Language Models (LLMs) using 11 datasets that test cognitive and linguistic failures like memorization traps, logic (Modus Tollens), and pattern matching. While the authors mention social bias, toxicity, and AI alignment as motivations for this work, the paper does not benchmark religion, faith traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
